message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on the facts. The facts describe a scheme: a pharmaceutical company representative (邓某) pays a hospital cashier (刘某) to bribe doctors (路某, 向某) to prescribe a drug. This is illegal. Potential crimes: "行贿罪" (bribery) for the person giving bribes (邓某) and "受贿罪" (accepting bribes) for the doctors and possibly the cashier. Also "非法经营罪"? But the core is bribery. But the facts only mention individuals. So crimes: 行贿罪; 受贿罪; 介绍贿赂罪. Also "非法收受回扣" is part of受贿. So list these three separated by ';'.

Thus answer: [罪名]行贿罪;受贿罪;介绍贿赂罪<eoa>
